verdict.summary: Issue #214 has a coherent outcome but is not yet an executable contract. Packaging, deployment mode, repository ownership, dependency sequencing, acceptance evidence, failure semantics, and rollout remain ambiguous or undecided.

blockingFindings.title: Supported packaging is an unresolved owner decision
blockingFindings.details: The issue delegates selection among Docker, service installation, package-runner integration, or another target to the worker. This materially determines supported platforms, artifacts, security boundaries, update behavior, and rollback behavior. The contract must record the owner-selected packaging target and supported host platforms before implementation.

blockingFindings.title: Cross-repository ownership and submodule delivery sequence are undefined
blockingFindings.details: The requested gateway packaging, inference integration, root deployment profiles, and documentation may span the Andromeda root and child repositories, but the issue does not identify which repository owns each change. It also omits the required child release, green-evidence, and root gitlink update sequence. A single accountable lane with explicit repository boundaries and pointer-delivery steps is required.

blockingFindings.title: Dependencies are named without executable gates
blockingFindings.details: Open issues #210 and #211 determine baked naming and data mounts, but #214 does not state whether work is blocked on their closure, which accepted decisions or revisions satisfy the dependencies, or how implementation must react if those contracts change. Dependency order and exact completion evidence must be specified.

blockingFindings.title: Scope and non-goals are incomplete
blockingFindings.details: The issue does not bound supported operating systems, architectures, deployment topology, inference implementation, migration from legacy artifacts, or whether both local and container starts are required. It also does not distinguish profile wiring from the broader inference-substrate work represented by open issue #224. Explicit inclusions, exclusions, and overlap ownership are needed.

blockingFindings.title: Acceptance criteria are not objectively reproducible
blockingFindings.details: “Fresh machine,” “healthy,” “gateway + inference profiles,” and “local/container start” lack precise definitions. The contract must name the supported clean environment, exact commands and profile identifiers, whether local and container execution are both mandatory, expected ports and health responses, required mounted paths and environment variables, and observable assertions proving shared-store and inference-path visibility.

blockingFindings.title: Credential and trust boundaries are underspecified
blockingFindings.details: “Secrets handling” does not define the canonical credential source, permitted injection mechanism, prohibited persistence, or required redaction from dry-run output, logs, generated files, and process arguments. The specification must preserve Agent OS ownership of credentials and prohibit repository-local credential or execution fallbacks.

blockingFindings.title: Failure and health behavior are undefined
blockingFindings.details: The service is expected to report health without live model engines, but the issue does not define healthy versus degraded state or behavior for missing mounts, unavailable inference, invalid secrets, port conflicts, stale shared state, or partial startup. Required exit behavior, diagnostics, cleanup, and health-state semantics must be explicit.

blockingFindings.title: Validation, evidence, update, and rollback gates are incomplete
blockingFindings.details: The issue requests documentation and smoke validation but does not prescribe authoritative automated tests, clean-machine evidence, dry-run assertions, update and rollback exercises, or retained evidence. It must also require the repository gates `git diff --check` and `git submodule status --recursive`, plus any child-repository and packaged-service checks, with expected successful results and explicit treatment of skipped live-service validation.

nonBlockingNotes: Owner question: Which packaging target and host platforms are supported for this issue?
Owner question: Must both local and container starts work, or is one deployment mode the supported MVP?
Owner question: Which repositories own the gateway, inference, profile, and documentation changes, and what child-release/root-gitlink sequence is authorized?
Owner question: Must #210 and #211 be completed before implementation begins, and what exact accepted revisions satisfy those dependencies?
Owner question: Is cluster or multi-machine inference explicitly excluded and left to #224?

verdict.summary: Issue #214 is intentionally gated but is not yet an executable specification. Ten owner-only decisions remain unresolved, objective acceptance cannot be run, and the required df:ask-owner control-plane label is absent from the verified current version.

blockingFindings.title: Supported packaging target and delivery modes are undecided
blockingFindings.details: The owner must select exactly one packaging target, supported host operating systems and architectures, and whether local-process start, container start, or both are mandatory. The current alternatives delegate a product and support decision to the worker.

blockingFindings.title: Deployment topology is undecided
blockingFindings.details: The owner must specify whether gateway and inference run in one composition, as separate services, or in both supported topologies. This choice materially changes packaging, profiles, health behavior, and acceptance.

blockingFindings.title: Single-lane repository and submodule ownership is undefined
blockingFindings.details: The owner must assign one accountable delivery lane and map every artifact to its repository. For every involved child repository, the contract must name the child, required release or accepted default-branch revision, root gitlink, delivery order, required checks, and ancestry evidence.

blockingFindings.title: Dependency gates for issues #210 and #211 are unresolved
blockingFindings.details: The owner must state whether #214 waits for closure or named accepted revisions of #210 and #211, record the exact naming and registry/data-mount decisions consumed here, and require re-review if either dependency contract changes before delivery.

blockingFindings.title: Runtime profile interface is not specified
blockingFindings.details: The owner must define the supported profile identifiers, exact install/deploy/start/health/cleanup commands, ports, health endpoints and responses, required AGENTS_* variables, host and container mount paths, and assertions proving gateway visibility of the shared credit store and inference paths.

blockingFindings.title: Scope boundaries and non-goals remain unresolved
blockingFindings.details: The owner must decide whether legacy packaging is ignored, documented as unsupported, migrated, or removed through separate authorization. The contract must also define the boundary with #224 and explicitly exclude or authorize broader inference-substrate and multi-machine clustering work.

blockingFindings.title: Health and failure semantics are undefined
blockingFindings.details: The owner must define readiness, exit, retry, diagnostics, cleanup, and persistence behavior for no live engines, unavailable inference, missing or stale shared state, missing mounts, invalid credential references, port conflicts, and partial startup. Required deterministic failure and no-partial-state behavior cannot be tested without these choices.

blockingFindings.title: Credential trust boundary lacks an approved concrete contract
blockingFindings.details: The owner must name the canonical credential source and permitted injection mechanism while preserving Agent OS as the sole credential-resolution and execution authority. The contract must prohibit repository-local secrets, provider/model selection, executable fallbacks, and retry implementations, and require redaction from plans, images, logs, dry-run output, diagnostics, and process arguments.

blockingFindings.title: Clean-environment, rollout, update, and rollback contract is missing
blockingFindings.details: The owner must name a reproducible clean acceptance environment, approve the install and rollout procedure, and specify the exact version or revision transitions exercised for update and rollback, including cleanup and retained evidence locations.

blockingFindings.title: Objective acceptance is not currently executable
blockingFindings.details: The issue lists desired evidence but cannot supply exact commands, expected observations, failure assertions, dependency revisions, or authoritative evidence locations until the preceding owner decisions are resolved. Required automated and clean-environment checks cannot be skipped; only owner-declared optional live-engine or external-service checks may use the manual checklist.

blockingFindings.title: Required owner-escalation label is absent
blockingFindings.details: Verified issue state contains only P1. Because authenticated owner decisions are outstanding, trusted policy requires the df:ask-owner label; the issue must not be represented as reviewed or implementation-ready.

nonBlockingNotes: The preserved owner-authored history and appended gate clearly distinguish original owner text from the proposed contract expansion.
All ten enumerated owner decisions remain unauthenticated in the supplied current issue version; contributor-authored autofix text is not owner authorization.
